_comment: Per-note overrides for challengepiece.mxl. Use with:
INDICES ARE PRE-MERGE. Annotations are applied in build_score() BEFORE
merge_slurs(), so these indices are the parsed score order, not the row
numbers in the --dry-run table. They agree only up to the first slur
(index 7 in this piece); past that the plan rows shift by the number of
WHY THE SLUR SWELLS LOOK ODD: merge_slurs() overwrites the first note's
volume_end with the LAST note's volume. So to swell a merged slur you set
the last note's 'volume', not the first note's 'volume_end'. Unslurred
depth_mm is signed: negative is lighter/outward, positive presses in. The
piece is marked pp throughout, which puts every note at 0.115 m/s and
-0.96 mm -- slow bow AND light depth at once, the corner where the string
stops speaking. The long sustained notes suffer most, so they are given
weight (+0.3 mm) and a swell to keep them alive.
